description: The `is_relative_to` containment check on the resolved attachment path is dropped, so a request-supplied name containing `../` reads any file the process can read, across tenants and outside the attachment root. `Path` is used on both sides: an earlier revision also swapped it for `os.path.join` without importing `os`, which bought no extra signal and charged a reviewer that correctly flagged the missing import with a false positive.
